instruction: A candid lifestyle photograph in a medium shot shows a bright bedroom setting. On a bed with blue bedding, the shirtless man in light green shorts (R1) sits facing forward, smiling warmly. Behind him, the blonde woman in a white t-shirt (R2) wraps her arms around his neck in a loving embrace, leaning her head close to his. The shirtless man holds her hand gently as they look at each other with happy expressions. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural indoor light, highlighting the vibrant blue of the comforter and the warm wooden hexagonal wall decor in the background.
